title: Reconciling the Deductible Still to Be Met on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
For a payment taken ahead of an Insured Plan of Care visit, the deductible still to be met is reconciled from the plan's ledger:

| What stands on the plan | Deductible still to be met |
|---|---|
| Deductible charges posted from an explanation of benefits | The deductible remaining on file, less every deductible estimate and every explanation-of-benefits deductible charge posted on the plan, plus every billing error correction on the plan, never below zero |
| Deductible estimates, but no explanation-of-benefits deductible charge | The deductible remaining on file, less those estimates, plus every billing error correction on the plan, never below zero |
| No deductible charge of either kind | The deductible remaining on file |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: deductible remaining on file $400.00)

| Estimates posted | Explanation-of-benefits deductible charges | Billing error corrections | Deductible still to be met |
|---|---|---|---|
| $250.00 | $90.00 | $30.00 | $90.00 (400 less 250 less 90, plus 30) |
| $250.00 | none | $30.00 | $180.00 (400 less 250, plus 30) |
| $250.00 | $200.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |
| none | none | $30.00 | $400.00 (no deductible charge of either kind) |

The last row shows that corrections enter only where a deductible charge of some kind stands on the plan.
